title: The Fauna XL Cargo Cage Is Here!
content:
The XL Cargo Cage is an oversized version of Fauna’s original cage, which has been an aesthetic, functional, and affordable addition to the cargo cage market since launching last August. Building on that success, the XL keeps the same proven design as its smaller sibling, but doubles the carrying capacity from 3kg to 6kg. That means more room for stuff like the rain gear you don’t want to cautiously bring but probably should, or that extra cozy fleece for downtime at camp…

Fauna XL Cargo Cage Quick Hits

  • Body: 3 mm 304 stainless steel
  • Foot: 5 mm 304 stainless steel
  • Finish: Black sandtex powder coat, or raw tumbled stainless
  • Weight 185 g (body), 88 g (foot)
  • Includes 1× cage body, 1× foot, 3× M5 × 16 mm bolts, 3× TPU spacers
  • Made in Canada
  • Load Capacity Tested to 6 kg. Always consider the strength of your mounts, particularly on carbon frames.
  • Pricing
    • Single – $79.00 CAD/ $59.00 USD
    • Two Pack – $139.00 CAD/ $99.00 USD
  • Free Shipping Worldwide (over $25.00 CAD)

The XL also carries over the functionality of its petite predecessor, with an adjustable foot that raises and lowers to help dial in the perfect fit for whatever bag or cargo you’re carrying. The foot can be removed entirely to make room for extra-long cargo, shave off a few grams, or to pair the cage with Fauna’s Front Cargo System.

Fauna keeps it local, with production based in BC. The XL Cargo Cage is manufactured in Delta, and packaged right here in Vancouver. It’s built tough, pairing the 3mm tumbled 304 stainless steel body with a burly 5mm removable stainless steel foot. The body weighs in at 185g, with the foot adding another 88g for a total weight of 273g. Beyond its strength and durability, the stainless steel construction offers excellent fatigue life and enough resilience to be bent back into shape without cracking if it takes a hit out on the trail.

The XL combines thoughtful design, plenty of capacity, and a value-focused price, all while keeping production close to home Modelled after the original Fauna cargo cage, the XL is everything we’ve loved about Fauna so far, only bigger, bolder and ready for more.

Like the original, the XL Cargo Cage comes ready to mount with everything you need to get rolling. Each cage includes three M5x16 bolts and three TPU spacers, alongside the cage body and adjustable foot. It’s a straightforward package designed to make mounting simple and get your cargo secured without unnecessary fuss.

Get yours today at Fauna Components.
